name: World Trade Center North Tower (1 WTC)
coordSource: Wikipedia coordinates for the tower (1 World Trade Center (1970-2001))
cause: Hit by American Airlines Flight 11 in the September 11 attacks.

name: World Trade Center South Tower (2 WTC)
coordSource: Wikipedia coordinates for the tower (2 World Trade Center (1971-2001))
cause: Hit by United Airlines Flight 175 in the September 11 attacks.

name: AXA Tower
coordSource: Singapore OneMap address point for 8 Shenton Way (now The Skywaters)
cause: Made way for the Skywaters Residences at 8 Shenton Way.

name: Union Carbide Building (270 Park Avenue)
coordSource: Derived: Wikipedia says the 52-storey slab stood on the Park Avenue side of the block, set back ~33-50 ft from the Park Avenue lot line
cause: Made way for the new JPMorganChase headquarters at 270 Park Avenue.

name: Singer Building
coordSource: Derived: the tower stood at the north-west corner of Broadway and Liberty Street, set back 30 ft from Broadway (Wikipedia)
cause: Made way for One Liberty Plaza.

name: 7 World Trade Center (1987)
coordSource: Derived: the 1987 building ran ~100 m west from West Broadway between Barclay and Vesey streets (Wikipedia)
cause: Collapsed on September 11 after fires started by debris from the North Tower.

name: CPF Building
coordSource: Singapore OneMap address point for 79 Robinson Road (CapitaSky, built on the same plot)
cause: Made way for 79 Robinson Road (now CapitaSky).

name: Fuji Xerox Towers
coordSource: Singapore OneMap address point for 80 Anson Road (Newport Plaza, under construction on the same plot)
cause: Made way for Newport Plaza and Newport Residences.

name: Morrison Hotel
coordSource: Estimated from the hotel's address (15-29 S. Clark St, east side of Clark just south of Madison)
cause: Made way for the First National Bank Building (now Chase Tower).

name: World Trade Center Building
coordSource: Wikipedia (EN and JA) coordinates for the building
cause: Made way for the Hamamatsucho 2-chome redevelopment and its new World Trade Center towers.

name: Deutsche Bank Building
cause: Damaged and contaminated in the September 11 attacks, it stood empty until it was taken down floor by floor.

name: UIC Building
coordSource: Wikipedia coordinates for the old building
cause: Made way for V on Shenton.

name: One Meridian Plaza
coordSource: CTBUH coordinate of The Residences at the Ritz-Carlton (dataset id 3454), which was built on the One Meridian Plaza site at 15th St & South Penn Square
cause: Gutted by a fire in 1991 that killed three firefighters, it stood empty until it was taken down.

name: Menara Tun Razak
coordSource: Average of two web points for the site on Jalan Raja Laut (penang-traveltips and SkyscraperPage), not checked against imagery
cause: Taken down in Tradewinds Corp's redevelopment of the site, though some reports say it was refurbished instead.
